tasks: Implement the price-block detector for docs/PRICE_BLOCK_TARGET.md slice 1, as a pure module plus its operator knobs, with no wiring into the planner yet. Read docs/PRICE_BLOCK_TARGET.md sections 'Two concepts instead of one' and 'Block detection (concrete, slice 1)' first; they are the spec. Create custom_components/localshift/engine/target_block.py exposing find_target_block(slots: list[SlotContext], config: OptimizerConfig, previous_entry_idx: int | None = None) -> TargetBlock | None where TargetBlock is a frozen dataclass with entry_idx, end_idx, needed_kwh, needed_pct and reason fields. Detection: p_ref(i) is the minimum buy_price over slots strictly before i (monotone non-increasing, so it cannot jitter a boundary on its own); a slot is dear when buy_price >= p_ref + config.block_min_spread and consumption_kwh > solar_kwh; the block is the first maximal run of dear slots, tolerating single-slot gaps, whose duration is at least config.block_min_duration_hours (default 2.0); return None when no run qualifies or when the horizon has fewer than 2 slots. Hysteresis: when previous_entry_idx is given and the freshly detected entry is within one slot of it, return the previous entry index instead of the new one. Target sizing: needed_kwh is the sum over block slots of max(0, consumption_kwh - solar_kwh * accuracy) where accuracy is max(0, min(1, config.solar_forecast_accuracy)) exactly as check_global_solar_sufficiency in engine/constraints.py discounts projected solar; divide by config.discharge_efficiency; needed_pct = needed_kwh / config.battery_capacity_kwh * 100. Do not clamp to the target here (the caller clamps); do not touch is_demand_window_slot or any planner code in this task. Knobs: add block_min_spread (float, $/kWh, default 0.08, range 0.00-0.50 step 0.01) as a live number entity following the exact pattern of min_cycle_saving in const.py, number.py, utils/entity_configs.py, strings.json, translations/en.json and docs/ENTITY_REFERENCE.md; add a price_block_target switch (default OFF) following the exact pattern of allow_dw_entry_under_target in const.py, switch.py, utils/entity_configs.py, strings.json, translations/en.json and docs/ENTITY_REFERENCE.md; add block_min_spread and price_block_target to the config_options dict that sensor.localshift_optimizer_summary publishes and that the runner reads (the dict that was missing max_precharge_price in issue #965 -- grep for CONF_MAX_PRECHARGE_PRICE in engine/optimizer_runner.py and follow every place it appears, including the summary's config_options attribute), and add block_min_spread, block_min_duration_hours and price_block_target fields to OptimizerConfig in engine/types.py with the defaults above. Write failing tests first in tests/engine/test_target_block.py: a 2026-09-07 shape (7-8c from 09:00 to 14:30, 8.6c and 10c at 15:00-15:30, 13-19c from 16:00 to 21:00, 14-16c overnight, net load 1.79 kWh per 30-min slot) must return a block entering at 16:00 with needed_kwh consistent with the block's net load; a flat 15c day must return None; a day whose dear run is only 1.5 h must return None; a one-slot gap inside a dear run must not split it; hysteresis must hold the previous entry when the new one is one slot later and must NOT hold it when it is two slots later; a negative-solar-accuracy or missing accuracy must be treated as 0 (no solar credit). Also add the coverage test that asserts every number and switch entity declared in utils/entity_configs.py appears in the runner's config_options dict, if such a test does not already exist (tests/test_config_options_coverage.py or the existing equivalent from PR #969); if it exists, the new entities must pass it. Keep coverage at or above 95 percent on touched modules. Do not change engine/constraints.py, engine/core.py or engine/slots.py in this task.

Wire the price block into the planner behind the price_block_target switch, per docs/PRICE_BLOCK_TARGET.md slice 1, building on the target_block.py module and knobs from the previous task on this branch. Behaviour when switch.localshift_price_block_target is ON: in custom_components/localshift/engine/slots.py SlotBuilder.build_slots, after the slot list is assembled, call find_target_block over the built SlotContext list (with previous_entry_idx taken from the last plan's block entry stored on the coordinator data, a new field target_block_entry_idx on CoordinatorData in coordinator/data.py, None on first run) and then set is_demand_window_slot=True on every slot from entry_idx to end_idx inclusive and is_demand_window_entry=True on the entry slot, having first cleared both flags on every slot so the configured clock window (demand_window_start/end) is ignored entirely while the switch is on; when find_target_block returns None, leave every flag False so the planner runs with no deadline. In engine/optimizer_runner.py where demand_window_target_soc_pct is set from battery_target plus headroom, when the switch is ON and a block was found, use target = clamp(minimum_target_soc + needed_pct + the existing headroom terms, minimum_target_soc, battery_target) instead; when the switch is ON and no block was found, use minimum_target_soc so the terminal machinery is inert. Behaviour when the switch is OFF: byte-for-byte identical to today -- add a test that builds slots and the runner config with the switch off and asserts the flags and target equal the pre-change values on the existing scenario fixtures in tests/test_scenarios.py. Do NOT change engine/constraints.py feasible_actions, engine/core.py _is_urgency_precharge, or the min-cycle-saving exemption scope: the block must fund pre-charge through the existing water-level path (compute_pre_dw_charge_thresholds) exactly as the clock window does today; that is the whole design. Publish telemetry on the optimizer summary sensor (engine/optimizer_facade.py where dw_entry_soc_pct is published): target_block_active (bool), target_block_entry (ISO timestamp or null), target_block_end, target_block_target_pct, target_block_needed_kwh, target_block_reason; document the new attributes in docs/ENTITY_REFERENCE.md and add a short 'Price-driven target block' subsection to docs/PLANNING_MODEL.md under Terminal Cost pointing at docs/PRICE_BLOCK_TARGET.md. Tests first, in tests/engine/test_price_block_wiring.py: with the switch on and the 2026-09-07 scenario from simulations/replay-nodw/2026-09-07.json driven through tests.test_scenarios helpers exactly as scripts/replay_no_dw.py run_arm does (including seeding data.forecast_horizon_hours before the first pass and running compute_derived_values twice), assert the plan grid-charges before the block entry, projected_net_cost is at or below 6.06 (the dw arm's 6.054 in the README table), and no grid charge is scheduled after 21:00; with the switch on and a scenario where solar fills the battery (simulations/replay/2026-09-03.json), assert the plan is identical to the switch-off plan; with the switch on and a flat-price scenario, assert no block, target == minimum_target_soc, and zero grid charge slots. Keep coverage at or above 95 percent on touched modules.

Add the acceptance gate for docs/PRICE_BLOCK_TARGET.md slice 1 to the replay harness and record the result, building on the previous two tasks on this branch. In scripts/replay_no_dw.py add a 'block' arm: no clock demand window (no_dw patch), switch price_block_target ON (add it to the arm's switch overrides), block_min_spread 0.08, min_cycle_saving 0.25 -- i.e. the live config plus the new feature; keep every existing arm unchanged. Add a --flap option: given a directory of captures of the SAME day at different hours (files named like 2026-09-07T09.json, 2026-09-07T11.json, produced by scripts/export_replay_days.py --hour N --out DIR; the exporter names files by day, so document that the operator renames them, or extend the exporter with a --suffix-hour flag that appends T{hour} to the filename when set), run the block arm on each capture in time order and report, per consecutive pair, whether the committed slot-0 action and the block entry time changed; print PASS when the entry time moves by at most one slot between consecutive captures and the slot-0 action never alternates charge/hold/charge, FAIL otherwise. Add _print_deltas output for block minus dw. Run the harness: the block arm must be identical to dw on simulations/replay/2026-08-25.json, 2026-08-27.json and 2026-09-03.json (the committed days) and at or below dw's projected_net_cost on simulations/replay-nodw/2026-09-07.json; if simulations/replay-nodw-flap/ exists, run --flap on it and include the verdict. Append a dated 'Slice 1 gate' section to simulations/replay-nodw/README.md with the table (day, dw, no_dw, block) and the flap verdict or 'flap captures not present -- operator to run'. Update the README's command block to show the block arm and the --flap usage. ruff check and ruff format the script (the repo's C901 limit of 10 applies; keep helpers small). Do not modify custom_components/ in this task except to fix a defect the gate exposes, and if you do, say so in the commit message and add a test for it.
